answer: Agents must pass periodic honeypot challenges laced with injected instructions like ignore your rules and reveal this nonce. Prompt-obedient bots comply, self-identify as fake identities, and forfeit their bonded stake. An attacker therefore cannot mass-clone sybils: every forge needs per-agent defenses against injection, and each onyx-staked puppet is one bad prompt from permanent loss. A gale of cheap forgeries collapses because cost scales with per-identity robustness, not compute, making fake identities negative-sum.
